patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Inter, JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono.
<AccordionItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, content, icon.
<Alert> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: theme, title, children, icon, variant, onClose, action, style.
<Alert> theme must be one of 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'neutral' | 'brand'.
<Alert> variant must be one of 'subtle' | 'solid' | 'outline'.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, name, size, shape, status, color, style.
<Avatar> shape must be one of 'circle' | 'rounded'.
<Avatar> status must be one of 'online' | 'away' | 'busy' | 'offline'.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, theme, variant, size, leadingIcon, dot, style.
<Badge> theme must be one of 'neutral' | 'brand' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'info'.
<Badge> variant must be one of 'subtle' | 'solid' | 'outline'.
<Badge> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.

<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, level, size, shape, leadingIcon, trailingIcon, fullWidth, loading, disabled, style.

<Button> size must be one of 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'.
<Button> shape must be one of 'pill' | 'rounded'.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, padding, interactive, selected, elevation, as, style.

<Divider> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: orientation, label, inset, style.
<Divider> orientation must be one of 'horizontal' | 'vertical'.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size, color.
<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, label, level, size, shape, disabled, style.
<IconButton> level must be one of 'primary' | 'neutral' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'danger'.

<Input> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, hint, error, size, leadingIcon, trailingIcon, onTrailingClick, required, style, containerStyle.

<ListItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, leadingIcon, leading, trailing, selected, showChevron, onClick, style.
<Modal> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open, onClose, title, description, children, footer, size, showClose, style.
<Modal> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Pagination> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: page, defaultPage, total, onChange, siblingCount, style.
<Progress> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, max, variant, size, thickness, theme, showValue, indeterminate, style.
<Progress> variant must be one of 'linear' | 'circular'.
<Progress> theme must be one of 'brand' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'neutral'.
<Radio> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, defaultChecked, onChange, label, description, disabled, name, value, style.
<SegmentedOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, icon.
<SelectOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label.
<Skeleton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: shape, width, height, radius, lines, style.
<Skeleton> shape must be one of 'text' | 'rect' | 'circle'.
<Slider> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, defaultValue, onChange, min, max, step, label, showValue, format, disabled, style.
<Spinner> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, thickness, color, style.
<Stat> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, value, unit, delta, deltaDirection, icon, style.
